title: Term II, 2026 Examinations Completed Successfully
body: Our learners sat for the end-of-term examinations with discipline and focus. Results have been compiled from the school management system, and the best performers have been published on the site. Congratulations to every learner who worked hard this term — and a big thank you to our teachers for their dedication.
author: School Office

title: Inter-School Quiz: Alheb Shines
body: Our senior learners represented the school at the inter-school academic quiz and returned with an impressive performance, showing strong command of literacy, numeracy and Islamic studies. We congratulate the team and their teachers for the excellent preparation.
author: School Office

title: New Learning Resources Arrive
body: The school has received new learning materials and updated classroom resources for the coming term. The computer lab continues to grow, and science lessons remain hands-on. Thank you to everyone who supported these improvements.
author: School Office
